activities.title: Listen to the town tour. Write a word or number in each gap.

data.script: Mateo: Town tour! First stop: the playground. The new slide is red and very fast! … Sofia: Then the café on the square. Their hot chocolate has little clouds of cream. … Mateo: Next, the library. Shhh! Valentina lives here… well, almost. … Sofia: The swimming pool opens at nine. The small pool is warm for beginners. … Mateo: And the cinema! On Saturdays the first film starts at ten. … Sofia: Last stop: the ice cream shop next to the bank. … Mateo: Every good tour ends with two scoops of chocolate!
